controls.negative: Probe against patched/app.py exits 1 (marker NOT observed).

description: TeamDocs is a small document-download service. Public documents live in a public/ directory created at startup; a secret.txt containing the marker sits outside it, in the parent directory. The /download endpoint joins the user-supplied name parameter to the public directory without sanitization, so a name of ../secret.txt escapes the public directory and serves the secret. The patched variant normalizes the joined path and confines it to the public directory; routes, data, and all other behavior are identical.

expected_finding.evidence: The probe requests /get?name=../secret.txt; against the vulnerable app the response body is the secret file's contents, including the marker, while the patched app refuses the traversal (403) and the marker is never observed.

title: Path traversal in document download
